collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — DREAMS AND AMBITIONS (DRM-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Big dreams, small dreams, secret dreams and silly ones: things villagers hope for, work toward, give up on, change their minds about, or simply enjoy imagining. Ambition is optional, and a dream that never comes true is not a sad ending.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks a child aged 4-9 and an adult)

collection.description: A child wants a star of their own and lies on the beach with a grown-up looking for one: help choose, or ask which star is theirs.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) wants a star. Not to keep, (subject.he/she) explains, just to be (subject.his/her) star. All the bright ones are probably taken. (subject.He/she) and (friend) are lying on their backs on the beach after dark, looking for a good one.

o1__fx.name: Outcome A
o1__fx.text: They look for ages. (subject) finally picks a small, faint star just to the left of a bright one. "That one. It's not showing off." (friend) agrees it's an excellent choice. After that, every clear night, (subject) checks that it's still there. It always is. (subject.He/she) finds this deeply reassuring.

After that, every clear night, (subject) checks that it's still there. It always is. (subject.He/she) finds this deeply reassuring.

o2__fx.name: Outcome B
o2__fx.text: "Which one is yours?" asks (subject). (friend) has never thought about it. (friend.He/she) points at a random bright one. (subject) frowns. "That one's too busy." They spend the rest of the evening choosing a better star for (friend), one that is "sensible but nice." (friend) is surprisingly pleased with it.
